version.description: Raised by the server on every change; clients send the version they last saw so conflicts can be spotted.

deletedAt.description: Set when the record is deleted; deleted records are kept so other devices learn of the deletion.

defaults.description: Filled into a match made from this template, or from a competition that uses it, when the match has none. Not the user's role: that depends on the match.

description: A reusable match format, such as "U12 league: 2×30, 5 min half-time".
